- Pooled r understates signal (between-site capacity variance): within-site mean r(power, solar_elevation) = 0.74 (vs 0.34 pooled); humidity -0.50; temperature 0.42.

- Weather gaps cluster in specific months (>80% missing: 2021-08, 2021-09, 2021-10, 2021-11, 2021-12, 2022-01, 2022-02, 2022-03, 2022-04) — consistent with sensor outages rather than continuous decay.
- Site 11 daily-energy trace shows clear seasonality with occasional zero-runs (outages/cloud anomalies) worth watching during modeling.
